title: Snowflake SQL cheat sheet
summary: High-frequency Snowflake SQL for warehouses, clones, time travel, and TASK/STREAM patterns.

tips.title: Zero-copy clone for safe experiments
tips.body: Clone a table or schema before destructive transforms; clones are metadata-cheap.

tips.title: Time travel peek
tips.body: Inspect a prior version without restoring.

tips.title: Warehouse sizing intuition
tips.body: Scale up for single large queries; scale out (multi-cluster) for concurrency. Prefer auto-suspend ≤ 60s for ad-hoc warehouses.

tips.title: QUALIFY with windows
tips.body: Filter window results without a subquery.
tips.code:
SELECT * FROM events
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts DESC) = 1;

title: PySpark transform patterns
summary: Idiomatic DataFrame transforms for joins, late data, and testable pipelines.

tips.title: Prefer columns over UDFs
tips.body: Built-in functions stay in the JVM Catalyst plan; Python UDFs serialize row-by-row.
tips.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
df = df.withColumn("dt", F.to_date("ts"))

tips.title: Broadcast small dimensions
tips.body: Hint broadcast for dimension tables that fit in executor memory.
tips.code:
from pyspark.sql.functions import broadcast
out = facts.join(broadcast(dims), "id")

tips.title: Repartition before wide writes
tips.body: Control output file counts explicitly before Delta/Parquet writes to avoid tiny-file storms.

tips.title: Incremental watermark mindset
tips.body: For streaming/structured streaming, set watermarks on event time before windowed aggregations.

title: Git daily commands for data PRs
summary: Safe daily Git workflows for dbt/SQL/Python repos—rebase, fixup, and bisect without drama.

tips.title: Update feature branch cleanly
tips.body: Prefer rebase onto main for linear history on personal branches.
tips.code: git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

tips.title: Fixup last commit message
tips.body: Amend only if the commit is still local / not shared.
tips.code: git commit --amend -m "fix: correct late-arriving key logic"

tips.title: Find which commit broke a test
tips.code:
git bisect start
git bisect bad
git bisect good <known-good-sha>

title: Databricks notebook & jobs shortcuts
summary: Keyboard and ops shortcuts that speed debugging on interactive clusters and jobs.

tips.title: %run vs widgets
tips.body: Use widgets for parameterized jobs; reserve %run for shared setup cells you control.

tips.title: Job cluster vs all-purpose
tips.body: Production ETL should run on job clusters; keep all-purpose for exploration to control cost.

title: Python snippets for data engineers
summary: Pathlib, logging, retries, and config patterns that belong in every ETL utility module.

tips.title: Structured logging over print
tips.code:
import logging
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
log.info("loaded rows", extra={"count": n})

tips.title: Pathlib for local artifacts
tips.code:
from pathlib import Path
out = Path("artifacts") / f"report_{ds}.parquet"

tips.title: Tenacity-style retry sketch
tips.body: Wrap flaky API pulls with exponential backoff; never retry non-idempotent loads blindly.

title: SQL window functions quickref
summary: ROW_NUMBER, LAG/LEAD, and running totals—patterns you reuse in Snowflake and Spark SQL.

tips.title: Deduplicate to latest
tips.code: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY updated_at DESC)

tips.title: Previous period compare
tips.code: LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY month)

tips.title: Running total
tips.code: SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
